title: AI Engineer: Systems, Embeddings, RAG & Autonomous Agents
summary: A 10-week intensive bridge for software engineers transitioning to building production AI applications, vector retrieval architectures, structured outputs, and eval-driven autonomous agent loops.
assumptions: Assumes solid familiarity with backend APIs (Python or TypeScript) and Git.
Skips generic programming introductions and dives straight into transformer inference and prompt orchestration.
Workload structured for 8 hours per week with end-to-end coding assignments.

intake.goal: Move from software developer to AI engineer

phases.title: Phase 1: Transformer Foundations, Tokenization & Prompt Engineering
phases.goal: Understand how autoregressive transformers work under the hood and implement deterministic structured outputs.

project.title: Phase 1 Milestone: Eval-Driven Extraction Engine with JSON Schemas
project.brief: Build a production document extraction pipeline using structured outputs, few-shot prompting, and automated regression evaluations measuring accuracy against a benchmark test set.
acceptance_criteria: 100% schema validation compliance across 100 test documents using Zod/Pydantic
Automated cost and token latency logging per run
Regression test harness comparing prompt iterations
project.stretch: Add synthetic data generation loop to bootstrap domain edge cases.

sessions.title: How Large Language Models Work: Pre-training, Fine-Tuning & RLHF
sessions.objective: Grasp tokenization mechanics, context windows, sampling parameters (temperature, top_p), and the distinction between base and instruction-tuned models.
search_queries: Intro to Large Language Models Andrej Karpathy

video.title: Intro to Large Language Models
video.why: The definitive high-clarity engineering lecture on the entire modern LLM stack by former Tesla AI director.

alternate_video.title: But what is a neural network? | Deep learning, chapter 1
alternate_video.why: Intuitive geometric and mathematical foundation of matrix weights and activation functions.

checkpoints.question: Why does lowering temperature close to 0 produce more deterministic model output?
options: It sharpens the token probability distribution, favoring highest-probability logits
It forces the model to use cached responses
checkpoints.explanation: Lowering temperature scales down the logits before softmax, concentrating probabilities on the greedy top candidate.

checkpoints.question: What is the primary cause of hallucination in autoregressive models?
options: Next-token prediction optimizes statistical plausibility rather than ground truth verification
Insufficient RAM allocation on inference hosts
checkpoints.explanation: Autoregressive generation predicts the most plausible continuation given prior tokens without an external verification oracle.

checkpoints.question: Hands-on Verification: Compute token costs and latency
options: Measured token consumption and latency using tiktoken/tokenizer
Guessed cost based on word count
checkpoints.taskCriteria: Calculate token count for a 500-word prompt using BPE tokenizer and compute cost.
checkpoints.explanation: Understanding token economics is critical for AI software architecture.

sessions.title: Building GPT from Scratch: PyTorch Implementation
sessions.objective: Implement a character-level transformer decoder with multi-head self-attention to master tensor shapes and causal masking.
search_queries: Transformer self attention code from scratch

video.title: Let's build GPT: from scratch, in code, spelled out.
video.why: Masterclass breaking down every line of code behind transformer attention mechanisms.

sessions.title: Dense Vector Embeddings, Chunking Strategies & Cosine Similarity
sessions.objective: Convert unstructured text into high-dimensional embedding spaces, implement semantic chunking, and benchmark vector search.
search_queries: Embeddings and similarity search full course

video.title: Building LLM Applications with Vector Databases & RAG
video.why: Practical implementation of embedding generation, ingestion into vector stores, and prompt context stuffing.
